description: Source code for the 'SystemUserDetail' React component in Mattermost's admin console, managing user details including CPA fields, activation, MFA, and team assignments.

classes.name: SystemUserDetail
classes.description: React component class for managing and displaying detailed user information in the admin console, including CPA fields, activation, MFA, and team management.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Fetches user data and CPA values based on user ID, updates component state accordingly.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method to load user data and CPA fields when component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle method to check for unsaved changes and update navigation blocking.

methods.name: hasUnsavedChanges
methods.description: Determines if there are any unsaved changes in user data or CPA fields.

methods.name: hasCpaChanges
methods.description: Checks if CPA fields have been modified from their original values.

methods.name: isEditingOwnEmail
methods.description: Checks if the current user is editing their own email address.

methods.name: isCpaValueChanged
methods.description: Compares current and original CPA values to detect changes.

methods.name: resolveOptionNames
methods.description: Resolves option IDs to display names for select/multiselect CPA fields.

methods.name: handleTeamsLoaded
methods.description: Handles loading of team memberships for the user.

methods.name: handleAddUserToTeams
methods.description: Adds user to selected teams.

methods.name: handleActivateUser
methods.description: Activates the user account.

methods.name: handleDeactivateMember
methods.description: Deactivates the user account.

methods.name: handleRemoveMFA
methods.description: Removes MFA from the user.

methods.name: handleEmailChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the email input, with validation.

methods.name: handleCpaValueChange
methods.description: Handles changes to CPA field values, with validation.

methods.name: handleUsernameChange
methods.description: Handles changes to the username input, with validation.

methods.name: handleAuthDataChange
methods.description: Handles changes to auth data input, with validation.

methods.name: getChangedCpaFields
methods.description: Returns CPA fields that have been modified.

methods.name: renderCpaField
methods.description: Renders individual CPA fields with appropriate input types and validation.

methods.name: renderTwoColumnLayout
methods.description: Renders the user detail form in a two-column layout.
